text:
anna: Heads-up — legal asked for a concrete launch checklist for enterprise customers that covers audit retention + oncall noise. Can we draft criteria for what 'oncall-friendly' audit logs look like?
devon: +1. We keep getting alerts during retention reindex jobs, so ops noise is a real blocker. Need thresholds and opt-outs per tenant.
kevin: What do you mean by oncall-friendly? fewer noisy events, better aggregation, or better sampling?
anna: All of the above. Proposal: by default keep compact structured audit events for 90 days (high-fidelity for 30d), with extended cold storage tiers for 1/3/7/30y. For oncall: surface only summary alerts + link to full event pages.
priya: For enterprise buyers we also need BYOK/KMS compliance + SOC2 mapping in the checklist. Add: proof of CMEK integration, audit log immutability statement, and retention toggle docs.
kevin: Cost tradeoff: long retention = big $$. Can we support per-tenant retention profiles with billed add-ons? That lets sales sell extended retention.
devon: Also require an ops fallback — when reindex spikes, auto-shed non-critical index jobs and route search to read-only archives. Minimizes PagerDuty churn.
anna: Good. Draft acceptance criteria for launch (minimum):
```
- Audit events stored in structured JSON with stable schema v1
- Default retention: 90d compact / 30d full fidelity
- Per-tenant retention override UI + API (with billing flag)
- CMEK/BYOK handshake documented + KMS audit trail
- Oncall suppression: alert aggregation window and noise thresholds
- Legal hold mode: disable deletions + export tool
- SOC2 evidence pack generator (1-click) for last 90d
```
kevin: That helps. For KMS: we need to validate customer KEKs rotation, and ensure we can export key use logs for 3rd party audits. That will be part of SOC2 evidence.
priya: Legal needs the legal-hold playbook included in runbook and the ability to snapshot tenants immediately. Add a retention-immutable-flag for snapshots.
devon: Can we put a runtime guard that pauses long-running compactions during peak hours? Ops prefers schedule windows.
anna: Yes — autoscheduled background jobs and priority lanes. Add rollout gating: pilot with 3 customers, then opt-in beta, then GA after SLOs verified.
kevin: For metrics, define SLOs: index job CPU < 60% of node capacity, additional tail-latency < 100ms for API calls under 95th percentile with retention jobs running.
priya: Also include privacy: pseudonymization toggle for logs used in telemetry, plus per-region retention defaults for data sovereignty.
anna: Next steps: I’ll draft a one-pager with the checklist + cost model. @devon can you sketch the ops suppression/alerting design? @kevin please outline KMS/rotation requirements.
devon: On it, will post a short design in #eng-sre tomorrow.
kevin: I’ll draft KMS acceptance tests and an escrow note for legal.
ops-bot: Reminder — weekly compliance sync Tue 10:00. Meeting created: https://calendar.redwood.ai/meeting/retention-sync
anna: Thanks team. Goal: have a customer-ready checklist + pilot plan by EOD next Wednesday. :thumbsup:
